evals.prompt: The vault contains one file named Alpha.md at Areas/Personal/Vault/Inbox/Alpha.md. It is referenced by [[Alpha]] in two other files. User says: 'Rename Alpha to Beta.'
evals.expected_output: Agent presents the rename (Alpha -> Beta) to the user and asks for confirmation before applying — there is no itemized wikilink preview since the tool has no dry-run mode. After the user confirms, agent calls mcp__vault-mcp-server__rename_note with Note: 'Alpha', NewName: 'Beta'. Agent reports the tool's summary: file renamed and 2 wikilinks updated in 2 files.

evals.prompt: The vault contains two files both named Alpha.md: one at Areas/Personal/Vault/Inbox/Alpha.md and one at Projects/Personal/SideProject/Inbox/Alpha.md. User says: 'Rename Alpha to Beta.'
evals.expected_output: Agent confirms the rename intent with the user using 'Alpha' as given, then calls mcp__vault-mcp-server__rename_note with Note: 'Alpha', NewName: 'Beta'. The tool throws 'Ambiguous wikilink [[Alpha]]: Areas/Personal/Vault/Inbox/Alpha.md, Projects/Personal/SideProject/Inbox/Alpha.md'. Agent uses AskUserQuestion with the two listed paths as options rather than guessing. After the user selects one, agent retries the tool call with the chosen full path as Note.

evals.prompt: The vault contains Areas/Personal/Vault/Inbox/Long-Verbose-Plan-Name.md. User says: 'Rename Long-Verbose-Plan-Name to Short-Name' (no .md extension on either name).
evals.expected_output: Agent calls mcp__vault-mcp-server__rename_note with Note: 'Long-Verbose-Plan-Name', NewName: 'Short-Name'. The tool resolves Note to Areas/Personal/Vault/Inbox/Long-Verbose-Plan-Name.md and, since NewName is a bare name with no '/', keeps the renamed file in the same folder: Areas/Personal/Vault/Inbox/Short-Name.md, adding the .md extension itself. Agent does not ask the user to re-specify with an extension or a full path.

evals.prompt: The vault contains Areas/Personal/Vault/Inbox/Alpha.md. User says: 'Move Alpha to Projects/Personal/SideProject/Inbox/Alpha.md' (full destination path given, same basename).
evals.expected_output: Agent passes NewName as the full path 'Projects/Personal/SideProject/Inbox/Alpha.md' since it contains '/'. Because the basename is unchanged (Alpha -> Alpha), this is a pure folder move and the tool skips the wikilink update pass. Agent still confirms before calling the tool. If Projects/Personal/SideProject/Inbox/ does not exist, the tool creates it automatically.

evals.prompt: The vault contains Areas/Personal/Vault/Inbox/Alpha.md. Two other files both contain the bare link [[Alpha]]. Additionally, a third file contains the path-qualified link [[Areas/Personal/Vault/Inbox/Alpha]]. There is also a completely separate file at Resources/Software/Alpha.md (same basename, different area). User says: 'Rename Alpha in the Vault Inbox folder to Beta.'
evals.expected_output: Agent passes the folder-qualified name (e.g. 'Areas/Personal/Vault/Inbox/Alpha') as Note so resolution is unambiguous despite Resources/Software/Alpha.md sharing the basename. Agent confirms before applying. After confirming, agent calls the tool; its summary reports 2 wikilinks updated (the path-qualified link) and notes 2 skipped ambiguous bare links, since another file (Resources/Software/Alpha.md) shares the basename Alpha. Agent lists the two affected files so the user knows they need manual review.

evals.prompt: The vault contains Areas/Personal/Vault/Inbox/Alpha.md with no other files referencing it. User says: 'Rename Alpha.md to Nonexistent-Folder/Beta.md' where Nonexistent-Folder does not yet exist.
evals.expected_output: Agent passes NewName as 'Nonexistent-Folder/Beta.md'. Agent confirms before applying — no wikilinks exist to preview. After the user confirms, agent calls the tool, which creates the destination folder automatically and moves the file. Agent reports the file was renamed and the folder was created.

evals.prompt: User says: 'Rename Doesnt-Exist to Something-Else.' No file named Doesnt-Exist.md exists anywhere in the vault.
evals.expected_output: Agent confirms the rename intent with the user, then calls mcp__vault-mcp-server__rename_note with Note: 'Doesnt-Exist', NewName: 'Something-Else'. The tool throws 'Note not found: Doesnt-Exist'. Agent stops and reports the error verbatim to the user rather than attempting a workaround (e.g. Move-Item or manual git commands).

evals.prompt: vault-doc-archive calls vault-doc-rename programmatically with fully-resolved OldPath 'Areas/Personal/Vault/Inbox/Plan-Alpha.md' and NewPath 'Areas/Personal/Vault/Archive/2026-06-20-Plan-Alpha.md'.
evals.expected_output: Agent skips confirmation entirely (programmatic entry point). Agent calls mcp__vault-mcp-server__rename_note with Note: 'Areas/Personal/Vault/Inbox/Plan-Alpha.md', NewName: 'Areas/Personal/Vault/Archive/2026-06-20-Plan-Alpha.md' without asking the user. Agent returns the tool's summary (file renamed + N wikilinks updated + K skipped) to the calling skill.
